title: Bus driver dies after sudden medical emergency causes bus crash in Wellampitiya
summary: An SLTB bus driver died after suffering a sudden medical emergency while transporting nearly 50 passengers from Colombo to Ampara, causing the bus to veer out of control and crash into several roadside structures in Wellampitiya early yesterday morning.

title: NPPers receives ‘Santhosham’ from leading businessman following allowing solar project: MP
summary: A group of NPP politicians have received a santhosham from a leading businessman for allowing a solar power project on a land in the reserved forest area in Polonnaruwa, opposition MP Chamara Sampath Dassanayake alleged in Parliament yesterday.

title: Tragic end for wild jumbo after rescue attempt fails in Thanamalwila
summary: A 25-year-old wild elephant died during a rescue operation after falling into a narrow well in the Kudaoya area of Samagipura, Thanamalwila, despite desperate efforts by wildlife officials and local residents to save the animal.

title: Inland Revenue Amendment Act: Key changes explained
summary: The Inland Revenue (Amendment) Act No. 11 of 2026, which was certified on June 3, 2026, has introduced several significant changes to Sri Lanka’s tax framework. Here are some of the key amendments.

title: Sri Lanka plans settlement of outstanding amount to Australia
summary: After Sri Lanka lost US$ 2.5 million to cyber hackers, the Finance Ministry is now working with the relevant Australian authorities to settle the outstanding amount according to an agreed repayment schedule, a top source said.

title: Don’t guess at home whether it’s dengue or flu-get checked early: Doctors
summary: Sri Lanka is currently seeing both dengue fever and seasonal influenza circulating at the same time, and doctors are urging the public not to try and self-diagnose at home.

title: Unqualified instructors blamed for rising road fatalities
summary: In the wake of a worrying increase in fatal road accidents across the country, the Police Traffic Division has raised serious concerns over the quality of driver training and the regulation of driving schools.

title: 154 death row inmates cleared for Presidential Pardon remain in Prison after more than four years
summary: A total of 154 death row inmates who were recommended for release under a presidential pardon by several expert committees appointed by the Ministry of Justice in previous governments have remained behind bars for more than four years, according to prison sources.

title: Bribery Commission arrests Rakitha Rajapaksa, SJB organizer
summary: Attorney-at-Law Rakitha Rajapaksa, son of former Justice Minister Wijeyadasa Rajapakshe, and Charith Abeysinghe, the Samagi Jana Balawegaya (SJB) organizer for Horana, have been arrested by the Commission to Investigate Allegations of Bribery or Corruption (CIABOC).

title: They booked Rs 17-crore palace for wedding. Then she pushed fiance off cliff
summary: It had all the trappings of a dream wedding. Till a deadly twist. Planned and executed allegedly by the fiancee and her lover.

title: Strongest-in-a-century earthquakes hit Venezuela, buildings collapse in Caracas
summary: Back-to-back powerful earthquakes struck Venezuela in the early hours of Thursday (Indian Standard Time), causing widespread damage and collapsing buildings in the capital, Caracas, according to officials and monitoring agencies. The twin earthquakes, measuring 7.1 and 7.5 in magnitude, were the most powerful to hit the Latin American country in a century.

title: Post-mortem confirms female physiotherapist was strangled to death
summary: The post-mortem examination has confirmed that the suspicious death of a female physiotherapist from the Ampara Hospital in the Teldeniya area was a homicide caused by strangulation.

title: Elon Musk loses trillionaire status as global tech rout hits SpaceX
summary: Tech entrepreneur Elon Musk lost his trillionaire status on Tuesday, less than two weeks after becoming the first person to achieve it following SpaceX’s public debut, according to data from Bloomberg.

title: Teldeniya car death suspect arrested; Trail of multi-million rupee scams exposed
summary: A series of financial frauds has been uncovered following the arrest of a suspect wanted in connection with the death of a woman found inside a car in Teldeniya.

title: FIFA World Cup 2026 Round of 32 Bracket and Schedule: Road to the Final Takes Shape
summary: For the first time in the tournament’s history, 48 nations are chasing 32 knockout spots. Here is the complete bracket, schedule, and survival guide for Sri Lankan fans tracking the run to the Finals.
